# Ownflow

> Ownflow is a voice-first work buddy for Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 14.4 or later). Dictation is free, unlimited and runs on your Mac, so it is private. During online calls, a live meeting partner follows the discussion, uses your context, and drafts what you need next. No bot joins the call, and audio is not stored.

Ownflow is free for everyone during the test. Meetings and cloud features need a Google sign-in, with no invitation. An iPhone app is coming soon. Claude Desktop, Claude Code and Cursor can read your Ownflow meetings through a local, read-only MCP server.

## Product

- [Home](https://ownflow.ai/): What Ownflow does: private dictation, the live meeting partner, context from your calendar, past meetings, screen, Linear, Notion and Slack, and what leaves your Mac.
- [Meetings](https://ownflow.ai/meetings.html): How meeting notes work, where audio, transcripts and notes go, and how long they are kept.
- [Connect your AI](https://ownflow.ai/connect-ai.html): Set up Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor to read your Ownflow meetings. The five read-only tools, the trust model and the setup steps.
- [Pricing](https://ownflow.ai/pricing.html): Free dictation, then €15, €30 and €90 a month for meetings, the live agent and everything.
- [Download](https://ownflow.ai/download.html): Install steps for the Mac app.

## Trust and help

- [Privacy notice](https://ownflow.ai/privacy.html): What Ownflow stores, who receives it and for how long.
- [Support](https://ownflow.ai/support.html): Install help, permissions and answers to common questions.
